test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59053695394f6607ccf118420c09c3e059e61b84a4443cfb9233a2a558eb49da.png]
solution:
As per the given figure series:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The symbol (+) moves in the shown direction and changes into (×), the arrow sign decreases by (1) and the bottom logo increases by (1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdda122914762e4e86bbda5e7917d5c854d844059c5c44ee27c80ab48e534d1d.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The symbol (×) moves in the shown direction and changes into (+), the arrow sign decreases by (1) and the bottom logo increases by (1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd5cfa86468340c3b209939fa718a03a2acdfcbcad318faeb1382fdff9e90e6c.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The symbol (+) moves in the shown direction and changes into (×), the arrow sign decreases by (1) and the bottom logo increases by (1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e59e8ba40daf32583ecb9c48d40c56102b00e82a21a6451c254a3246c31a9b55.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer figure:**

The symbol (×) moves in the shown direction and changes into (+), the arrow sign decreases by (1) and the bottom logo increases by (1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88ae7f6e3f02ea522d511ce914b2d38a324c7cebedf4ed50d3865f8ec37ddaec.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
